inlines.v: UNTA'MED, adjective 1. Not reclaimed from wildness; not domesticated; not made familiar with man; as an untamed beast. 2. Not subdued; not brought under control; as a turbulent, untamed mind. 3. Not softened or rendered mild by culture; as an untamed people.
